Body.Content:
The table edit visual now responds to filters and slicers applied within the Microsoft Power BI report. When users filter the report using a slicer or other supported report filtering experience, the table edit visual reflects that filter context and displays the relevant dimension records.

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/business-performance-planning/table-edit

GA date: November CY2026
